# f5xc_site_mesh_group (Data Source)

Site mesh group is a configuration tool to provide Site to Site<br>connectivity<br><br>Set of sites in a site mesh group are defined by a virtual site.<br><br>The site mesh groups can be of type HUB or SPOKE. Where,<br>- SITE_MESH_GROUP_TYPE_HUB_FULL_MESH<br>'virtual_site' in the Site Mesh Group defines list of HUB Sites for the Site Mesh Group<br>A HUB Site will route traffic between all its Spoke Sites.<br><br>Current release can support only a single site in Site Mesh Group of this type<br><br>- SITE_MESH_GROUP_TYPE_SPOKE<br>'virtual_site' selects list of Spoke sites. Traffic between two Spoke sites is<br>routed thru Hub Sites.<br><br>'hub' field refers to another Site Mesh Group. The 'virtual_site' in this Site Mesh Group<br>gives list of Hub Sites for the Spokes. Every Spoke site will create tunnels with all the<br>Hub Sites<br><br>- SITE_MESH_GROUP_TYPE_FULL_MESH<br>'virtual_site' selects list of Sites. Full mesh of tunnels is created between all sites that<br>are member of virtual_site<br><br>NOTE :<br>- The tunnels created by Site Mesh Group are in addition to the tunnels created from CE to its 'Connected REs'<br>- The tunnels can be setup over either public network or a private network and tunnels can be of type IPSec only<br>- A site can be member of either SITE_MESH_GROUP_TYPE_HUB_FULL_MESH or SITE_MESH_GROUP_TYPE_SPOKE. Not both

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: Site Mesh Group - Full

data "f5xc_site_mesh_group" "example" {
  name      = f5xc_site_mesh_group.example.name
  namespace = f5xc_site_mesh_group.example.namespace
}
```

## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) name This is the name of configuration object. It has to be unique within the namespace. It can only be specified during create API and cannot be changed during replace API. The value of name has to follow DNS-1035 format.
- `namespace` (String) namespace This defines the workspace within which each the configuration object is to be created. Must be a DNS_LABEL format. For a namespace object itself, namespace value will be ''
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `annotations` (Map of String) annotations Annotations is an unstructured key value map stored with a resource that may be set by external tools to store and retrieve arbitrary metadata. They are not queryable and should be preserved when modifying objects.
- `bfd_choice` (Attributes) BFD Choice Options for enabling or disabling BFD for the Site Mesh Group. BFD is used for fast failure detection. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--bfd_choice))
- `description` (String) description Human readable description for the object
- `labels` (Map of String) labels Map of string keys and values that can be used to organize and categorize (scope and select) objects as chosen by the user. Values specified here will be used by selector expression
- `mesh_choice` (Attributes) Mesh Choice Type of Site to Site connectivity (Spoke, Hub or Full Mesh) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--mesh_choice))
- `re_fallback_choice` (Attributes) RE Fallback Fallback to RE Connectivity when the SMG fails (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--re_fallback_choice))
- `uid` (String) uid uid is the unique in time and space value for this object. Object create will fail if provided by the client and the value exists in the system. Typically generated by the server on successful creation of an object and is not allowed to change once populated. Shadowed by SystemObjectMeta's uid field.
- `virtual_site` (Attributes List) virtual_site Set of sites for which this mesh group config is valid. If 'Type' is Spoke, then it gives set of spoke sites. If 'Type' is Hub, then it gives set of hub sites. If 'Type' is Full Mesh, then it gives set of sites that are connected in full mesh. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--virtual_site))
